youtube_title: Friend Fainted: Splash Water or Legs Up? Brave vs Normal #22 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BRAVE vs NORMAL — WHO'S RIGHT? #22. A friend faints at a college function. Brave splashes water on his face and tries to make him drink; Normal lays him flat and raises his legs. Who is right?
Answer: Normal. Never give an unconscious person water, they can choke, and don't splash or slap the face. Lay them flat, raise the legs about 30 cm, give air. Not awake within a minute? Call 112.
Source: MedlinePlus (US National Library of Medicine) and St John Ambulance first aid.
